The grid is a \(4\times 4\) square, so its total area is
\[
4\cdot 4=16.
\]

The shaded polygon is the entire square except for two congruent right triangles on the right. Each triangle has legs of length \(2\), so each has area
\[
\frac12(2)(2)=2.
\]

Therefore, the shaded area is
\[
16-2-2=12.
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
